scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w shared
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w shared && npm run test:coverage -w server && npm run test:coverage -w client && node scripts/check-coverage.mjs
